details.description: Ministral 3 3B Instruct (2512) is the smallest model in Mistral AI's Ministral 3 family, an instruction-tuned dense (non-mixture-of-experts) chat model with about 3.4 billion language-model parameters, released in December 2025 as part of Mistral's v25.12 release line. Mistral describes it as replacing its earlier Ministral 3B (v24.1) model and designs it for lightweight, edge-friendly deployment; its FP8 build is reported to fit within about 8GB of VRAM. It supports function calling, JSON-format output, and LoRA fine-tuning.
advantages: Scores 72.1% on AIME25 and 83.0% on MATH, per Mistral's model card.
Mistral reports the FP8 build fits within about 8GB of VRAM, suited to resource-constrained edge deployment.
Supports LoRA fine-tuning, per its Fireworks AI model listing.
disadvantages: Scores lower than its larger Ministral 3 14B sibling on the same benchmarks, e.g. 72.1% vs 85.0% on AIME25, per Mistral's model card.
Positioned by Mistral for lightweight and edge deployment rather than frontier-level tasks, per its model card.
use_cases: Lightweight chat and instruction-following on edge or resource-constrained hardware
Multilingual tasks across the model's documented language set

notes: Mistral's own model card pairs this 3.4B language model with a 0.4B-parameter vision encoder for image input, but Bud's catalog lists this route as text-only (text_input/text_output only, no image_input), so vision-dependent use cases like image captioning are omitted and vision is not claimed as a capability here; the catalog's modality is kept as authoritative. Release date confirmed as December 2, 2025 on the Hugging Face page (Fireworks lists 11/30/2025, close but not identical; matches the 'v25.12' release line on Mistral's models-overview page). Removed an 'MMLU (5-shot): 70.7' evaluation the original write-up sourced to this model's Hugging Face card: that score is in the README's 'Base' comparison table (Ministral 3 3B Base vs. Qwen 3 4B Base, Gemma 3 4B Base), not the Instruct model this file describes, and no Instruct-specific MMLU score was found on any source checked (HF, Fireworks, Mistral docs).
